crossRefs.note: “The holy garments of Aaron shall be for his sons after him, to be anointed in them, and to be consecrated in them.
Seven days shall the son who is priest in his place put them on, when he comes into the Tent of Meeting to minister in…
and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand…
I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will…
Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further…
Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.
But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Eleazar
people.line: Son of Aaron, high priest after his father

translations.web: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”
translations.bsb: Remove Aaron’s priestly garments and put them on his son Eleazar. Aaron will be gathered to his people and will die there.”
translations.kjv: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die
translations.asv: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
